verses.1: In the sixth year of King Persia’s reign, a message was revealed to Daniel. His name was Beltsachar. The message was true, and it came from a great army. And among those who received this message were also those who understood it well.
verses.2: In those days, I, Daniel, wept for three weeks.
verses.3: I did not eat sweet bread; nor did I eat meat or wine. I did not even touch anything until three weeks had passed.
verses.4: And on the forty-second day of the first month, I was by the great river. It was called Hidakel.
verses.5: And I opened my eyes and looked around. There was a man who was bent over, with his clothes tied up in a bundle.
verses.6: And his face was like a bright flame; his eyes were like flames of fire. His fingers were like snakes of destruction. And the sound of his words was like the cry of a wolf.
verses.7: And I saw Daniel alone, with that vision. The people who were with me did not see that vision. But great fear fell upon them, and they fled in terror.
verses.8: And I remained alone, and I saw this great sight. But I no longer had any strength or energy left in me. My will became weak, and I couldn’t hold back my strength anymore.
verses.9: And I heard the sound of his words. When I heard his voice, I was terrified. My face turned pale.
verses.10: And behold, a hand touched me, and it moved my feet and hands.
verses.11: And Daniel said to me, “You are a man of great wisdom. You know well what I am speaking to you. Now that I have sent you to speak to you, let me stand with you in this situation. Let me follow your instructions.”
verses.12: And he said to me, “Do not fear, Daniel. For from that day forth, when you dedicated your heart to understanding and meditating on Your God’s words, they were heard. And I have come to speak in accordance with Your words.”
verses.13: And the king of Persia stood against me for forty-one days. Then, one of the chief officers came to help me. I remained there with the kings of Persia.
verses.14: And I came to understand what would happen to your people in the days to come. It was still possible that those days might come.
verses.15: And in his words, just like these words, I was forced to face the reality of the world, and I was defeated.
verses.16: And behold, it seems that human beings touch my lips. I open my mouth and speak to those who stand opposite me. My limbs become active, and I am not restrained by any force.
verses.17: And how can this servant of the Lord speak with the Lord? I now have no strength or energy left in me; neither spirit nor soul remains in me.
verses.18: And he gathered me together, and strengthened me, just as a man does.
verses.19: And he said, “Do not fear, O one who is blessed! May you be strong and firm. As he spoke with me, I became stronger. And I said, ‘Speak, O Lord, for you have strengthened me.’”
verses.20: And he said, “Do you know why I came to you? Now I will go back to fight against Ser Pars. And I will go forth and see what happens.”
verses.21: But I will tell you the truth in writing. No one is stronger than me in dealing with these matters, except for Micahel Sharkem.
